original_test_intent: Verify the SMBIOS Type 0 Embedded Controller Firmware Major Release component equals the approved EC firmware contract, or follows the platform's approved not-specified rule, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type 0 plus platform EC identity, verify how the installed tool renders combined EC firmware revision, extract the major component or sentinel, compare with the EC image manifest, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves applicability, expected EC major component and plan. Collection, parsing, reboot and comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Platform EC presence/identity and image manifest
Expected EC major component or not-specified sentinel
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not query or flash the EC through a write path.
Preserve full Type 0/errors and distinguish absent, not-specified and numeric zero.
Do not use BIOS revision or BMC firmware as an EC substitute.
Stop on component mapping ambiguity, drift or reboot failure.
agent_execution_scope: Collect Type 0/tool/platform EC identity, extract the verified major component/sentinel and compare before/after reboot.
Do not invent EC mapping, run an EC update or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve EC applicability, image mapping, expected component/sentinel and recovery.
Resolve inconsistencies and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Fragile: dmidecode may expose a combined `Firmware Revision` rather than the literal major label; hidden stderr and insecure transport are rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full sudo dmidecode -t 0 and tool version/errors, verify EC revision rendering and extract the major component deterministically before/after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The linked script, EC major scope and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the SMBIOS EC revision to the actual platform EC/image manifest, preserve combined major/minor and sentinel, and compare only the major component across reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 0 platforms implementing EC firmware release fields.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode/script, BIOS and EC image versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform EC firmware manifest and SMBIOS field baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds EC component identity, applicability and safe combined-field parsing.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: EC identity, expected major and sentinel rule.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Servers may have multiple controllers; the SMBIOS EC field must be mapped to the intended component.

project_override_considerations: A project may declare the field not specified only with platform documentation; absence cannot be automatically treated as success.
expected_evidence: Approval, EC applicability/image mapping, expected major and tool versions
Raw pre-reboot Type 0 plus EC component extraction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and persistence criterion coherently target the EC major field; applicability/value are project inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The semantic field is defined. Missing EC mapping or package is readiness, not a permanent block.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains Type 0 collection but corrects label, error and EC-mapping weaknesses.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps applicability/sentinel and recovery controls while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Prevents substitution of a different management-controller version.

review_improvement: Makes the exact embedded controller and sentinel semantics explicit before interpreting the numeric component.
independent_technical_reasoning: After approval, the read/reboot/read workflow is software-controlled and no human UI action is required; FULLY AUTOMATABLE applies.
